title: English Practice Quiz 0492
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.
